entities.description: A full-body shot of a standing African man wearing traditional Maasai attire, including a red and blue patterned shuka wrapped around his body and tied with a blue sash. He is adorned with multiple necklaces of white and red beads, a blue beaded armband, and a distinctive headdress featuring a single upright feather with white and brown tips.

clothing.sash: blue fabric belt tied at waist
clothing.necklaces: multiple strands of white and red beads
clothing.bracelets: white and red beaded bracelets on both wrists
clothing.headdress: single upright feather with white and brown tips, attached to head with red band

attributes.background: dry, grassy landscape with sparse trees

entities.description: A full-body shot of a standing man with dark skin, wearing a red patterned wrap skirt and a white sash tied at the waist. He is adorned with multiple necklaces of white and red beads, blue glass beads, and a single black feather headdress, with a neutral expression and arms at his sides.

accessories.necklaces: multiple strands of white, red, and blue beads

entities.description: A full-body shot of a standing Maasai man wearing a vibrant red shuka with thin horizontal stripes and a blue sash tied at the waist. He is adorned with elaborate necklaces of blue and red beads, a blue beaded headpiece with black and white feathers, and beaded bracelets on his wrists and ankles, standing barefoot on dry, dusty ground.

clothing.garment: red shuka with thin horizontal stripes

accessories.necklace: multiple strands of blue and red beads with a white pendant
accessories.headpiece: blue beaded band with black and white feathers
